headline: Gold Recovers After Sharp Weekly Drop
summary: Spot gold rose 3.5% to $3,654.97 an ounce after hitting its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday. The rebound follows a steep weekly decline.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a hedge against inflation and currency risk, so its price moves are watched across markets. Spot prices reflect the global over-the-counter market benchmark.
why_moved: Gold rebounded from its lowest level since September 2025 reached on Friday, after a steep weekly decline. The input does not state the cause of the rebound.
original_headline: El oro se recuperó después de la fuerte caída semanal
